name: mirage
text:
Reviewed the report your phone saved at 3:54 PM (v1.0.77). Nothing is broken badly, but five things stand out:
1) BoltOdds says 'you're on the free plan' (HTTP 403), so its sockets and snapshots are off. If the paid plan lapsed, that is yours to check. It is the only one that needs you.
2) Your phone asks GitHub for the bids file 113 times and gets 'not found' each time. The file isn't being published right now. It's harmless, but I'll make the phone stop asking.
3) ParlayAPI NCAAF answered with errors 23 times in a row. That is their side. The scan carried on without it.
4) Bids: /bin/bash of 2.71 is working. That is a money limit, not a bug.
5) Bets placed more than 6 h before the start average -0.4% against the closing price, against +1.8% inside 6 h. Results are 3 standard deviations below what the edges promised (-$98 against +$80 expected, 2,217 bets). I'll check the engine's digest before changing any rule.
Pinnodds' key is used up for about 4 h more, and Android Battery Saver is on for Vigilant (set it to Unrestricted). I can't yet confirm the vanishing-bets fix, because scanning has been paused since 14:26. Turn it back on when the wallet is funded and I'll check the next report.
